Please maintain present course until further notification. '''Frequency 934A-3B''' was a communications channel used by [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|''Tanquilla Beach'']]. The [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] required ships such as the ''[[FarStar]]'' to broadcast their intent and identification on the frequency.
